# Settings map (`STUDIO_*`)

Every `STUDIO_*` name the harness reads (harness/, scripts/, qa/*.mjs): 746 names, 561 documented in docs/, 185 undocumented.
Each line: the name, its default when the code shows a simple one, the files that use it, and the first docs/ page that explains it.
A name ending in `*` is a family (one setting per suffix). Undocumented names from before 2.66.0 are frozen in
`docs/settings-baseline.json`; a new undocumented one fails `node scripts/settings-map.mjs --check` (the docs gate runs it).
To document one: describe it (what it does, its default) on the docs/ page for its area, then rerun this script.

## Passed to your commands (5; not settings)

The harness sets these in the environment of a command it runs for you (a game script, an engine port command). You do not set them, and they are not in the counts.

- `STUDIO_LANE_COMMIT` · the lane's commit, for an engine port's preLand command
- `STUDIO_LANE_DIR` · the throwaway checkout of the engine repo the preLand command runs in
- `STUDIO_ENGINE_REPO` · the engine repo's folder, for the preLand command
- `STUDIO_ENGINE_LANE_DIR` · the porter's lane folder, for an engine's quickCheck command
- `STUDIO_TESTER_RUN_DIR` · the tester run folder, for the driver the tester runs (qa/tester-drive.mjs reads it when --run is not given)
